issues.title: Storybook not running
issues.body:
When we host Serge on Heroku, it's possible to enter the `Storybook` view using the `User interface review pages`:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/860b0c43-1576-4d53-a901-661c1bd94c92)

But, when I click on that, I just get this page:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/687e4a9e-9c79-41e2-b06d-81dcd2b81634)

This behaviour can be viewed on this PR:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2710

I'm pretty sure the problem arose due to changes to this file:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2716/files#diff-1846122c2c83a486a3693f7966aa522c34cf489f674185c4da0d9221683fd81f
